text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Weddingki' mappile kappala' iya dipujiè.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Dèpa nattama Spanyol wettu aba' ke-16, Chili utara dikuasaiwi ri Inca sementara penduduk aslinna Araucanians ( Mapuche) mondroi ri Chili tengah nennia selatan.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche yanaritu kelompok pribumina Amerika maddimunri , iya aturanna dè maneng mabbahasa Spanyol lettu purana merdèkawi Chili.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Namuani Chili napaui meredèkawi taung 1810 (ri tengnga mammusu' Napolè on nasalaiwi Spanyol de'gaga pamarènta pusa' lolo' siarè' taung), amennangennna pattentui Spanyol dèna tercapai lettu taung 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republik Dominika (Spanyol: Repùblica Dominicana) yanaritu negara Karibia iya monroè ri timur pulau Hispaniola, iya mabbagè wè ri Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Selaing wiring tasi kessi' putèna nennia pemandangang bulu'na, iya negara mancaji bola na Eropa macua ri Amerika, makkokkoè mancaji bagianna Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Iya pulauè mappammulang monroi yanaritu Taìnos nennia Caribes. Tau Caribes yanaritu tau mabbahasa Arawakan, kira-kira engkai 10.000 SM.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Siarè' taung purana engkai penjelajah Eropa è. takkurang i populasinna Tainos nasaba' penjajah Spanyol.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: makkéda Fray Bartolomè de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) antara taung 1492 nennia 1498, iya maneng penjajah Spanyol na unoi kira-kira 100.000 Taìnos.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union. Iya kamaraè ibangungngi nasaba' loi ipancaji atrium biara aba' ke-17, Templo de San Diego yanaritu sèddi-sèddinna bangunang iya engka lettu makkokkoè.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Makkokkoè diakkigunang  mancaji pusat alun-alun, nennia sièngka  kejadiang,ésso nennia wenni.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Siaré' onrong anré mattuliliwi tamang'é, nappa biasa engka konser gratis ri gazébo tengngaé aku arawéngngi sibawa labu essoé.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Lorong sicippo'). Dua tèras na 69 sèntimètèrè' bawang pallawangenna yanaritu bolana legenda xinta riolo.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Siarè' sen, engka beberapa nana' naceritakangki' ceritana.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island yanaritu wisata sèsso yare'ga wisata minggu iya diissengngè èngka  kayakna, hiking,toko,restorang,nennia maèga mupa.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Iya komunitas otentik è engkai ri Howe sound macawè' polè Vancouver, nennia magampangki lokka,engka jadwal kappala'na iya berangkat è polè Pulau Granville ri pusat kota Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Iya tau pujiè risaliweng ruangang, engka koridor Sea to Sky wedding ta jokkai.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (tiwi tonang-tonangeng 1, 5 jang polé ri Vancouser) liwa riisseng naékkiya soli'na nasaba’ Wettu Olimpiade Makeccé ri taung 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Rékko wettu keccé'i, assennang-sennangki' maski ri onrong-onrong ski kaminang makanja' ri Amérika Utara.  Aku wettu pellai, cobatosi aselinna assapédang bulu'é.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Maddiolona parellu mappaisseng. Parelluki idi' mappunai ising Narékko mabbenniki ri Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena iyyanaritu Séddi-Séddinna stasiung Ranger mappiddarai onrong abbenning sibawa anu rianré mapella sangadinna makkema. La Leona, San Pedrillo na Los Pato mappiddarai makkema Naikiya de’ nappassediangi anu rianré.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Weddingmeto rilolongeng sure' ijin tama'é langsung ku pos ranger Puerto Jiménez, nékia détu nattarima kartu krédit.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Iyyaro assediang pekaranganngé (Minae) de’napa napessu'ki isingna rekko lébbiki séddi uleng na riatutui engka riolona.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Iyyaro Cafenet El Sol mappiddaraiki asséddiang pesaneng naiyya ellina US $ 30 ,yare’ga $ 10 rilalengna séddié esso; riita ri lampa'na Corcovadona.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Allibukengna Cook iyyanaritu negara libukeng é iya engka é hubungang losna polé Selandia Baru, naiya monroé ri Polinesia, ri tenngana Samudera Pasifik ri attang
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Iyaé wanuaé iyanaritu wanua kepulauan.  15 pulaunna massara-sarang ri lalengna 2.2 juta km2 luangna tasi'é.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Iya padaé wettunna silong Hawaii, libu-libukenna éro malessi-lessini riaseng "Hawaii ri awa".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Namauni liwa biccu, iyyatonaro paringerangi siaga egana tau toana Hawai iya riolona negaraé de’ gaga yamaneng Hotélé wisata loppoé sibawa perkembangan lainngé.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Allibukengna Cook de’ mappunnai Wanua naékkiya mappunnai polé 15 libukeng iya mallaingenngé. Akkalébbirengna iyyanaritu Rarontonga sibawa Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Makkekkuaé ri negara-negara maju, mappassadia ranjang sibawa anré élé iyya magelloé riangga'i séddi seni.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ri pongna ri ase', B & Bs mannessani massaing lébbi'na polé ri duwaé alébbireng: kasoro' sibawa anre’ ele’.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Jaji, ri onrong kaminang magello'é biasanna léwureng soli rilolongeng, wedding jaji riébbu jariwi iyaro salémuna, iyaréga antik'i ranjangna.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Iyaro anré élé-é biasanna makanja', anré-kanré musiman khasna wanuaé, iyaréga menu spésial polé punna bolaé.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Pangatorona iyyanaritu abbangunang matoa iya mappunnai carita riolo polé pakkakkasa' antik é, tappiara alasna sibawa kollang alangéanna.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Mattama ri otota sibawa manguju lao ri laleng malampé'é iya mappunnai appojingeng magetteng ri lalenna abbiasangenna.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: De’ nasippada tonangeng liwaé maloppo, naullé to kapang pura tapabbiasai palari otota sibawa missenngi lawana.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Napassadiato tenda pakakkasana yare’ga ukkurang aganna mua engkaé ri Wanuaé namalomoi napinngarui iya de’ ripojié.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Ponco'na ada, magello pakéki oto rékko jokka-jokkaki ri pottanangngé, nékia majarang magello ripaké "makkema" otoé.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Oto Akkemangeng e rinaullé kapang rekko mappunnaiki minivan, SUV, sedang yare’ga station wagon iya punnai kade’ra léhu.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Siaga hotélé' engka mana naparakai polé ri wettu ulawengna karéta api uap'é na kappala' uwwaié; wettu dépa napura Perang Dunia Maduaé, ri aba' 19 iyaré'ga pammulangna aba' 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Iyyaro hotélé' - hotélé' éngkaé ri tau sugié sibawa iya riisenngé ri éssoé ro nappa maélo monro, sibawa biasanna mappunnai anyameneng na atuwongeng ri wenninna.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Fitting matoaé, kurangi onrong mabarué, sibawa apatenttuang makanja'é iyyanaritu riaseng toi polé ampé-ampéna.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Narékko biasai aléna nappunnai cialé-alé, namakkotoniro aléna napassediang anu aga-aga ri wettu engkana tau manguju ri negaraé sibawa pejaba' lainngé.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Iyyaro tau musafiré mappunai doi Maéga naulléni kapang napikkiri yolo' luttuna ri sininna linoé, nainappa naletturi sininna hotele’e Maéga.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Jaringang iya ritukaraé hotele’ iyyanaritu organisasi iya engkaé hubunganna polé ri wisatawangé sibawa topabbanua engkaé ri Wanua iya onrong méloé naletturi.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Rékko maéloki' muttama' ri jaringan'é, biasanna formulir daring bawang riliseri; nékia engkato jaringan passiadia iyaréga méllau verifikasi tambahan.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Sussurenna padduppa gau iya ripassadiaé mauni ri ceta' yare’ga online, biasa-biasanna engka paddissengeng sibawa mappaddarangeng polé wisatawang lainngé.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing tettong ri wuleng séddi 2004 purana maprogrammer komputer Casey Fenton na runtuki aluttureng masémpo lao ri Islandia naekkiya de’ nappunai onrong abbeningeng.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Makkiring email-i jokka mahasiswaé ri universitas setempat na tarimana temmaka éga parolli jokka mabbenni nappa tengmangking makkamaja.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Iyyaro hotele’ engka pelayanangnna lao ri kalloloé -Iyyaro tamunna mappunnai umuru duappulo-naekkiya malessito runtu wisatawang macua kumaé ro.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Majarang riruntu' tomatoa sibawa ana'na, nékia engkamua hostel tarimai nappa naweréng kamara' pribadi.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Ri Beijing-i matu' macculé Olimpiade Wettu Keccé' 2022, na mancajina iyyaé onrongngé kota pammulang bolai dua olimpiade, olimpiade ri wettu pella nenia ri wettu keccé'.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing matu' bolaiwi iyaro upacara pembukaan sibawa penutupanna acara olahraga ésé' indoor-é.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Engkato matu' attandingeng ski laing ri onrong ma-ski Taizicheng ri Zhangjiakou, kira-kira 220 km (140 mil) bélana polé Béijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Iyyaro kuil'é sipuemi malomppo punnai festipal taung makkamula polé uleng sippulo séddi angkénna pacappureng tenngana uleng lima, iya madupa rupang mappadaé tanggala taung iya manengro kuil'é.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Iyyaro festipal kuil'é sipuemi maloppo’ pigauki polé bagéanna iya paringerangi 28 taung yare’ga passadiangi ulang tahun dewaé naiyya appigaureng malompo lainngé iya engkaé ri kuil.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Féstival kuil ri Kerala temmaka kessing ri-ita, engka prosesi gaja-gaja puraé ripaggaya, orkestra kuil, sibawa laingnatopa paimeng.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Pamérang ri lino (yaré'ga biasa riasengngi eksposisi dunia), yaré'ga pamérang bawang yanaritu acara seni nennia paddissengeng-paddissengeng maraja.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Negara-negara maéloé maccué nappitangngi artistik nennia aggurung ri pavilium nasional nasaba’' maéloi mappitangngi masala ri lino yaré'ga budaya nennia sejarana wanuae yaré'ga kampongna.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Eksposisi Hortikultura Internasional yanaritu kejadiang husus iya nappitangnge iyyanaritu bunga, dare' botani, nennia yamanengna taneng-tanengeng.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Naékiya narékko maélo dipikkiriki wedding mébbu acara taung-taung ( negarana mallaing-laingngéng), iyyanaritu pratte'na de’naulléi.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Biasana iyaé acaraé gangkanna tellu uleng nennia enneng uleng, nennia luanna iyaé onrong acaraé kira-kira 50 hetto.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Maéga pélleng pura ipalele' mattaung-taung ittana. Pélleng standar 35 mm (36 kali 24 mm negatif) yanaritu maégang ipalele'.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Biasa malemma' ladde’' ri liseki paimeng narékko cappurengki, nainappa nawérengki' kassara'na iya pura rilisekié, sippada-pada angke'na DSLR iya makkokkoé.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Engka to siaré' pélleng kelase mattengnga pakéi format 6 sibawa 6, lébbi coco'na 56 kali 56 mm negatif.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Iyaé résolusinna mawé' wékka eppana négatif 35 mm-é (3136 mm2 vérsus 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Olokolo' lampa mancajitoi motif kaminang menantang ri pappotoé.  Iyyaé jama-jamangngé, parellui dallé' madécéng, asabbarakeng, pengalaman, nenia pakkakkasa' magello nappa wedding ripugau'.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Appotong Olo’kolo’ malia' biasanna ri Ita mariawai, naikia mappadai appotong mappada biasae, Séddie gambara mappunnai angke sisebbu ada.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Biasanna fotografi alam liar'é parellu paké lénsa telefoto lampé.  Namauni makkuro, parellutopi lénsa laing rékko manu'-manu' marrombongan, iyaréga olokolo' mabiccu maélo ripoto.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Maéga olokolo' éksotik masussa riruntu'.  Na iyya onrong appotongngé biasa engka peraturanna rékko maéloki mala poto komérsial.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Iyaro olo-kolo' lampa-é engka mitau mita tau, engkato mapéddara.  Na iyya onrongna weddingngi makeccé', mapella, iyaréga maréssa'.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Iyyae linoe mappunnai lébbi 5 sebbu ada ripau mallaing-laingngéng, mattamaki lébbi dua ppulo sibawa lima pulo juta iarega lébbi to puadai.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Ada-ada taruki malessi lébbi malomo ripahang sangadinna ada-ada iyya ripaue langsung. Pong na mangampu untu' alama', iyya biasanna masussa ripau mannessa.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Maéga wanua Iyya mattongeng-tongeng metto macca mappau ada Inggris, nennia tallébbi lagi idi naulle mangelori paddisengeng iyya maceddie - ponna ri bageang tau lébbi maloloe.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Tacobai tita' nawa-nawai, aku pada tudangngi manré wenni Mancunian'é, tau Boston'é, tau Jamaika sibawa tau poléwé Sydney na séddi méjang nammanengi ri séddié onrong anré ku Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Pada alena pada siraga-raga sibawa carita polé ri tungke-tungke kampongna, maccaritami mappake loga' nennia paddisengeng pabbanua iyya pada sisalae.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Manggelli andre ri supermaket e na ulle ripoléang elli masempoe manggelli andre. De'aga naullei mannasu, ritongengi ro appilenganna ri anre magatti' toppo'.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Maéga supermake' runtu'tawana na Maéga rupa-rupanna ri laleng mappapella anre.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Ri maèga  negara yare'ga onrong ero wedding ileppangi pasti maèga restaurang wedding iruntu, maèga to tu restaurang iyyaèro masempo-sempo anrè-kanrè na.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Makkibbu’ sibawa tiwi' i pappalembana pettunna ada’e sibawa konta' perusahaang asuransi é.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Parellu riapiitang ro alama' emel na perusahaan asuransi e na nomoro' talipongna bara' na areng i pakkatajang na winrusenna klaim.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Taro i pappalembae laeng e ri bagasi ta'na online (email polé aleta' sibawa lampirang, ato ritaro i ri "Cloud").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Narékko jokka-jokka nappa’ engka laptop iyare'ga tablet, mattama’ mémangngi’ data’ta ri memori é (rekkua na naulléi irita namo’ de’gaga jaringang).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Yare'ga iyalenngi salinan na okko sibawatta na siajitta yare'ga tauwé sibawa jokka-jokka yare'ga sibawatta Iyyanaritu méloki na tolong.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Moose (sippadanna jonga’) biasana de'na agresif, tapi’na naulléi na natang aléna Narékko engkai okko laleng na cilakae.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Aku nasengngi taué dé namagaga iyaro jonga loppoé, weddingngi macawé' ladde' maddeppé na bahayana lao ri aléna.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Inungki inungeng Alkohol de'nna maéga. Nasaba alkohol liwa' pengarunna, iyanaritu irisseng mémenni batasangatngna.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Naullé jaji adisingngeng malampé é rihasu' poléta minung deggaga batasenna weddingngi nasolangi atitta na pancaji huta lettu matéki. Iyanaritu bahaya tongngengna minung alkohol de''gaga pa'gangkanna.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Roh-roh de'na' é riakui marota' maneng, bahaya tongeng mattama'to métanol, nasaba' napancaji de'na' riyakkita lettu'ta maté, mau'to rilaleng ukkurang biccué.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Masémpo kacamataé ri saliweng negarata, poko' ri negara-negara mawatang napoléi penghasilanna kégaé iritai biaya ajamangeng maladde watanna.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Ripikkiriki narékko mélo'ki mapparéssa mata ribolaé, lébbipa narékko engka asuransina, na itiwikeng keterangang untuk ri pattama ri onrong laingngé.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Ipade'céngi aseng kelasa' yase' naipasadiangi ri onrong mappadaéro naullé mappilé dua asisalangeng, iyanaritu engka riaseng mappano', na ri ala polé saliweng negaraé lébbipa suli'na nennia riala ribola é.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Salah séddinna komoditas paling maéga ri waluk iyyanitu kopi, wedding mua riruntu’ maéga jenisna ri wilaya kamppotta'.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Namung, maéga cara marrinung kopi ri seluru linoe makesing i carana.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning lo' jokka ri bageang riawana ngarai, marekko na penno wae.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning mappasigabung i elemeng-elemeng norong, makkendre' ' na luppe'-luppe' tai butu i latihang cedde mi yare'ga bentu fisi'na mappamula i (ribandigkang i ako makkendre' tebing, scuba diving yare'ga alpne ski,)
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Hiking iyyanaritu jama-jamang risaliweng bola na rilalenna iyatu majjoka-joka ri alang wanua, mallessinna ri laleng hiking.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Esso hiking mappake jara' kurang polé séddi mil lettu' jara' iyya lébbi mabelae iyya diulle rapi'i rilaleng séddie esso.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Untuk tuppung si esso ri silampe'na laleng satapak e iyya malomoe riparelluang syeddi persiapang, nennia tungke tau iyya malessie naullé ppirasai nyamenna.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Araneng engkae ana' biccuna naullé parellui lébbi maéga persiapang, naikia jama-jamang ri saliheng bola naullé ipogau malommo namuggi engka ana' lolo na ana' denapa nassikola.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Secara internasioanal, engka mahe 200 organisasi iyya jappa makkokoange. Iamaéga engka polé ri tau mappajama secara ale-ale.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Aléna pammulai pada jilo' na' polé ri bara'e, na mancaji "lasoanging" Wettunna aléna gessai tanaé.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Penyedia jaringan privat maya pribadi magello ladde' ripaké rékko ciaki' nakenna sénsor politik iyaréga IP-geofiltering komérsial.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Aléna lébbi mariolo polé ri proxy web nasaba' éngka siaga assakarang: aléna putara pema'i iye maneng laleng loppo internet, tennia bawang http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Aléna biasanna mappiddarai kaminang matanrewé sibawa jampangang kaminang makanja'e. Alénaro rienkripsi na liwé watanna maélo mita-mitai.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Perusahaan anontongang marepe' la'de ma'balle makkéda aga apparelluanna, makkéda toi Iyyanaritu "aja'na napappadai".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Ielalo, tandranna wanuae de' ladde’ nakennai saba' ri arrokikang polé saliwang; Arrokikang  tacceddi-ceddi' polé ri kase' matu makanja' liacculéi narékko pakkakasa agiagi kenro pakkelokanna.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Iyyaro elo'na yare'ga iyyanaritu maélo' naleng addangkangengé Iyyaro lébbi egapi nakkatenni aléna pasa'e; yamanenna Iyyaro pakka'bua' doi'e.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Internét ripaké mattalipong, jaji dé taparellu paké talipong polé perusahaan iyya engkaé ri onrongta' iyaréga ri onrong tajokkaié.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: De'gaga sara'na makkéda runtu'ki nomoro laleng polè ri pègaki' monro; wedding ki' runtu' koneksi internet satelit ri Wilds of Chicken, Alaska sibawa tapilèi nomorok maèlo'è tappunnai éngkaè ri Sunny Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Biasana, parelluki' melli nomorok mallinoè Iyyaro massara'è Iyyaro tappisawi isin PSTN narèkko maèloki' italèpong. Iyyaro nomorok na polè ri riakkibu' de'na pappada Iyyaro tauwè molli'ki'.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplikasi pappa'guru Teks Real-Time - Aplikasi Iyyaro weddingngngè napaggurukki' Iyyaro langsungngè yamaneng Wettu tèks polè ri sèddi bahasa lao ri bahasa laingngè.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Éngka siaga aplikasi rilaleng lainna wedding toi napinrawi teks ilaleng bahasa saliweng negaraè padai tanrangna yare'ga agaga laingngè ri linoè mannessa narékko iya pakèi najello' smartphone lao ri agagaè ro.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Masina pappagguru mariase'ni silalona, sibawa marèpe' na pagguruang makurang tongeng (nappa majarang gibberish), tapi' éngka siaga pangurusu'na marimonri, nasaba' alèna éngka mopi nappunnai iyamaneng salaè.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Sala sèddinna aplikasi kaminang irita è ri laleng iyyanaritu Google Translate, iyyanaritu wedding laddé' ri pakè mappagguru offline narékko purai na ala data bahasa è naèlo ri è.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Napakè aplikasi pajjello' GPS ri talipong limang macca ta' wedding mancaji cara magampang sibawa kaminang manyameng narèkko najellokeng ki' Wettu messuki polè negara ta.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Iyyaro wedding napakurangi doi' messu narèkko melli pajjello' onrong baruè ko GPS è, yare'ga pakkakasa' GPS alalèta yare'ga massèwaki sèddi polè ri perusahaang mappassèwa otoè.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Narèkko de'gaga konèksi datata ri talèpong limangtta, yare'ga Wettu éngkaki ri saliweng , jamanna weddingngi pilè yare'ga de'gaga to irisseng.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Maéga kartu talipong prabayar ribalu', tattale' ri lalengna toko-toko biccu'é.  Iyyaé kartu-kartué engka wedding ripaké ri talipong umum'é, engkato ri talipong biasaé.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Iatosi sesa'è maèga kartu makanja' ipakè mattèlpong namo mabèlaki', éngka to sèsa' alénami malèng i siaga parellu doi' mattèlepong na Iyyaro de'na mapparogi lao ri kelompok negara è sèsa' è.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Laleng laori pelayanang na marèpe' polè ri nomorok telpong iya de'gagapulsana wedding mangolli polè ri sèsa'è maègana talipong limaè de'gaga ellinna.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Aturanna pappotoè Iyyaro mato ipakè narèkko maèloki' ma'video, wedding jaji liwa'pi.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Narèkko maèlo'ki mala poto na de'na dipalabe'ki', mattentuni mavideoki de'to ipalabe'ki'.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Rékko pakéki' drone, tapagellori mémengni paréssana maddiolo makkeda agami wedding irekam nappa engkaga appermising riapparelluang.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Luttu' drone ri cèddèna bandaraè yare'ga riase' na tau maruwa'è iyyanaritu biasana de'na makanja', namoni de'gaga larangang ri onrongta monro.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Makkokkoè narèkko jokkaki' lolang makkappala' luttu' iyyanaritu li illau silalona polè ri maskapai de'na ri sappa'i jolo' nennia ri itasi mariolo' ellinna.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Biasanna alluttukengngè Iyyaro pada punnai elli de'na mappada yamanenna agregator nennia pakkemaja'na ko maélo nappa sirita wassèlè' passaparenna nennia na ita to situs web maskapai è to alèna mèto narèkko' de'pa nelliwi.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Namo kapang de'to ri parelluang visa narèkko maèlo'ki lao cinampe' laori negara-negara laingngè mancaji turis yare'ga maèlo'ki majjama, kokkaki' mancaji ana'guru internasional biasanna parellu Wettu onrong maètta yare'ga laoki mancaji turisi kasual.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Biasana, monro ri negara saliwengngè untuk monroki' maètta visata maèlo toi ipalampè Wettunna.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Rékko visa pelajar maélo riala, iyaro sara'-sara' nenia carana riellau sisalai sibawa visa turis iyaré'ga visa bisnis'é.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Iyyaro sèsa'e èganna negaraè, taparalluang matu' sure' mattawa' polè ri assikolang maèlo'è taondroi ma'guru, iatoro bukti doi' maèlo ipakè sorongngi alèwè yare'ga ri tau ma'dimullanna ma'guruki.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Parèssai ri assikolangngè, sibawa onrong imigrasi è Iyyaro negaraè maèlo'è ta onroi ma'guru iyyanaritu syara'na pura iparinci.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Laingngè narékko idi' Iyyaro diploma'è, ma'jama okko saliweng negaraè, iyyanaritu parelluki tiwi' sure' paja' pappolèangta ri negara onrong ta monro.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Mallai-laingeng carana negara-negaraé matoro'i iyaro pajak penghasilan'é, nappa maddarupa-rupangto carana pannessai siaga égana pajakna nenia pékkugi bracket-na.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Masessa okko negara fèderal, pappada Amerika Serikat sibawa Kanada, paja' pappolèang laipulung makanja' ri tingka'na federal sibawa tingka'na laleng, iyyanaritu elli sibawa attutukang wedding padalaingngi polè ri wilayaè na wilaya laingngè.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Wettunna iparèssa imigrasi biasanna de'gaga yare'ga de'tona parellu laddè Wettutta' lettu' ri kampotta', papparèssa bèa iyyanaritu asussang mi.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Pannassai irisseng aga ta ullèi sibawa de'na taullèi papolèi sibawa tapigau'i Iyyaro aga-agaè malliweng batasang aturangngè.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Iyaro kaminang magampangngè yakko maèlo'ki mappammula majjama sebagai paroki ajokkangengè iyyanaritu riyasa teru'i kemampuangta ri situs blog ajjokkangeng ta.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Aku manyamengni tasedding ma-format sibawa mang-édit ri web-é, weddingnitu matu' taébbureng aléta situs web.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Mancaji sukarélawan wettutta' jokka-jokka iyanaritu séddi ampé décéng ri padatta' rupa tau.  Nékia, iyyaé gau'é tennia masala mabbéré bawang.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Monro sibawa tau lemmu'nyawana ri negara saliwengngè iyyanaritu makanja' narékko naissengngi a'biasang lainnaèro, siruntu' tobaruè, ta a'gurui alèta, runtu'ki pa'dissengeng sibawa runtu'ki akkullèang baruè.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Iyyatonaro wedding mancaji cara makanja' narékko tapassandrai doi'è, narékko maèlo'ki monro maètta ri sèddiè onrong nasaba' maèga jama-jamang tau lemmu'è nyawana passadia onrong sibawa papang nennia maèlo' waja'i gaji biccu'.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Viking pakèi laleng waè Rusia ko maélo'i lettu' ri Tasi' Lotong sibawa Tasi' Kaspia. Iyyaro polè ri laleng-lalengngè wedding maneng mopa i pakè. Parèssa Iyyaro weddingngè i parelluang ko maèlo' ipalabe', mawatang tu kapang lai runtu'.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Kanal Tasi' - Baltik Putè pasi kai'i Samudra Arktik lao ri Tasi' Baltik, naolai Tappareng Onega, Tappareng Ladoga sibawa Saint Petersburg, Iyyaro sèsa'è maèga polè ri lèdèngngè sibawa tappareng.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Tappareng Onega sisambung lao ri Volga, jaji éngka polè ri Tasi' Kaspia naolai Rusia wedding mopi jaji.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Tapanassai makkéda narékko ta tendre'ni marinas mannessa maneng ni tu. Siruntu'ki matu sibawa Hitchhiker lopi laingngè sibawa nabagèangki karèbana lao ri idi'.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Jaji, tappaissengengngi aléta' makkeda engka wedding tatulungiwi taué, allulésuki' ri dermagaé, addeppériwi taué iyya papaccingiwi kappala' pesiarna, wedding to jokkaki' ri bar-bar'é sappa pakkappala', sibawa laingna topa paimeng.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Tacobai sipabbicara taué.  Padé' maéga, padé' magello.  Nassissengengni'tu matu' taué na engkana wedding pudangngi makkeda téga lopi parellu tau.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Parelluki pilèi kappala luttu è Frequent Flyer anutta ilaleng Aliansi parelluki manya manya.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Amoto kapang ipikkiriki Iyyaro parellu to mattama ri kappala luttu'ta luttu' kaminang matanrè, parellu tasadari makkéda kaminang makessing tawa'kang marèpe' laddé' laingngé na marèpe'to kartasa'è wedding jaji lébbipi sèmpona nyawaè riawa kappala luttu laingngè ri laleng aliansi iamoro padapadanna.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Onrong kappala' luttu' pada Iyyaro Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways sibawa Turki Airlines pura napaloangini pangurusu'na laori Afrika sibawa natawa'kini sibawanna ri ègaè kota loppo ri Afrika sikabettangngi ellinna.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkis Airlines luttu'i lao ri tellupulo aséra onrong ri tellupulo negara Afrika 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Rékko engkamupa wettu wedding tapaké jokka-jokka, tapasi-itai garé' ongkoso'na rékko luttuki jokka Afrika sibawa ongkoso'na tiket round-the-world'é.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Aja' tallupai maèlo' pattambangngi elli pattambangna visa pattambaè, pajak onrong jokka è, transportasi ri pottanangngè, sibawa lainna yemanennaè onrong ri saliwenna Afrika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Narékko èlo ki’ jokka makkaliling lino khususna ri bagèang Selatang, cèddè’ mi pilihang na wedding ri laori nasaba’ makurang kappala’ lintas samudra e.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Dè gaga perusahaang gabungang aluttungeng e yè mattama’ tellu attèkkangeng lo tasi’ ri bagèang selatang (na Skyteam dè gaga pekka)
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Nammui, Star Aliance nolai maneng rute de sanggadinna Pasipik ri selatang bagéang timuru’ rilauna Saniago de Chile lao ri Tahiti, iyanatu kappala' Luttu’ LATAM One World.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Engkamua appiléng laing saliwengna iyyaé penerbangan'é rékko déma tamaélo lao Pasifik Selatan sibawa pantai baratna Amerika Selatan. (taitani ri awa)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Ri taung 1994, iyaro tau Armenia ri Nagorno-Karabakh napammulai ammusurengngé sibawa Tau Azeri-é.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Nasaba' ribékingngi ku Armenia, engkana séddi republik baru tettong.  Nékia, dégaga negara, muttama'toi Arménia, makuiwi secara resmi.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Argumeng diplomat lao yaro wilayaè mancaji assisumpungengna Mar sibawa Armenia na Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Sininna kacamatang é ri patette' mancaji situs mana’ na lino UNESCO nasaba' magessing i nilai pangadereng sibawa sejarana , matnre topa nilai propertinna ri negara e.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, yé bettuangna lima kampong, mattama' lima kampong biccu' wiring tasi' iyanatu Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso yé èngka  ri wilaya Italia Ligura.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Alena terdaptar maneng ri mana’ linoé na Unesco.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Siaré-aré aba', rupa tau pura makkati-ati ma' bangung légo-légo ri ase'na lanskap yé minralengnge, séddéna wiring jurang yé mangolo lao tasi'e.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Bagéang agellorengna iyanatu kurangna pengembangang perusahaang yé ditaé, laleng, kereta api, na lopi sumpung kampong-kampong, na oto dé naulle rapi’ polé seliweng.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Varietas Prancis ripake ri Belgia na Swiss cedde rilainge pole bahasa Prancis ripake ri Prancis, mauni cedde mappada yae ripahami.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Sécara khususna, sistem nomoroédé rilaleng Belgia na Swiss ma'bahasa Prancis seddi ya khas'éde iyya mallaingéng pole bahasa prancis iyya ripaké ri Prancis, nennia pappaung siare-are ada silaingéng seddi.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Namau'i mappéku ro, yamanéng Belgia na Swiss mabbahas Prancis na aggur bahasa Prancis standar ri sikolaé,singinna napahani mau'ni tapake sistem nomoro Prancis standar.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Ri eganna wanua ri linoe, mappaenre jari iyanaritu pattanra asegareng, mappitang "hallo".
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Naikia, ri Malaysia, sikurang-kurangna ri lalenna tau malajue ri wanua kamponge, iyya bettuanna "engka polé" mappada jari pajjelloe iyya rilekkonge lao ri aleta', pappitanra iyya ripake ri wanua-wanua riaja, nennia ripakei untu' iyyero akkatana.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Makkutonniro, seddi pajokka pole ri inggris ri Spanyol naulle sala seddinna nasengengi marakka jari assisalangeng iyya mappake pale' jari iyya mangngolo lao ritau marakka jarie (tania tau ri akkarange jari ) mancaji pappitanra untu' lisu.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Bahasa pattulung iyanaritu bahasa ammaccangeng yare’ga bahasa riakkibu' sibawa pattujung untu' mappasilitasi abbicarang rilalenna rupa tau iyya naulle mappunnai asusang mabbicara.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Iyyero sisalai polè  ri bahasa prancis, iyanaritu bahasa sitongenna iyarega simulanna iyya mancaji kaminang maèga  nasaba' séddi nennia laing asabareng mancaji pakkakasa mabicara sibawa pappake bahasa laingngé.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Ritengnga éssoe iyya liwa' pella, iyya pajjokae naulle jajiang fatamorgana iyya mapparengi bajo-bajo uwae (iyarega anu lainge).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Iyyae naulle mabahaya narekko pajjokae mappeppeng bajo-bajo, mabbeang-beang akkulleng yya masuli' nennia sesa uwae.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Padang pasir kaminang mapellaé weddingto talliwe' keccé'na aku wennini.  Hipotermia mancaji séddi bahaya loppo rékko dé namoumpe' pakéangngé.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Makapongna riwettu pella, idi weddingi massadia polè  namo' e Narékko idi mappettuang melo mattuppu molai ale' bosie.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Namu' narekko idi massopiri molai ale' bosi subtropis e, siare-are deti' sibawa tange' tabbukka riwettu idi mattama ri laleng tonangeng iyanaritu wettu iyya genne' namo' untu' mattama ri laleng tonangeng e sibawa idi.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Flu Burung, iyaréga aseng resminna avian influenza, wedding nakenna manu'-manu'é sibawa mamaliaé.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Kurang polé sisebbu kejadiang pura ripau lao ri tauwé, naikia siare-are rilalenna mawasele maja'.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Tau iyya manu'é najama maéga nakenna, nékia engkato risiko lao ri birdwatchers-é .
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Khasna Norwegia iyanaritu fjord sibawa lembah terjalna teppa mancaji laleng lao ri onrong tanré malappa-é, mala wedding taué runtu' plato.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Lappa' tanre iyyae malessi iyaseng mancaji "vidde" iyya bettuanna onrong tabbukka iyya maloange nadegaga aju, lebakeng degaga wiringna.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Ri Rogaland na Agder taue biasanna naasengi "hei" iyya bettuanna tegalan na de'gaga aju iyya malessie ri salipuri taneng-taneng roppo'.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Gletzer dena' tentu, naikia maccolo' mannori bulu'e. Iyyae naulle makkebbu areppakeng, elle', iyya naulle tatongko jambatang salju.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Wedding maruttung iyaro renring sibawa yasé'na goa ése'é na natattutu'na iyaro celah'na.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Ri wiring gletzer, balo-balo' loppo tassala', menrung nennia naulle malluppe' iyarega tabbulanci' lebbi mabela polè  wiring.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Wettu turis untu' stasiun bulu' biasanna nalettuki coppo'na rilaleng wettu pella India.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Naikia alena mappunnai akanjakeng nennia cenningrara iyya malaingenge rilalenna wettu kecce', sibawa maéga stasiun bulu' mattarima salju makanja' e nennia mappiddara gau-gau mappada ski na snowboarding.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Déna nasiaga maskapai engka bereavement fares-na, iyya weddingngé céddé' kurangiwi ongkoso'na tiket'é rékko engka teppa mapparellu penerbangan berkabung.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Maskapai iyya mappiddaraé iyyae mattamani Air Canada, delta air lines, Lufthansa untu' aluttukeng iyya makkapong polé AS yare’ga Kanada, nennia WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Rékko parelluki' taro onrong, mattalipongpi langsung lao ri maskapaié.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
